# Tyler Preisser — Full Reference

> Chief Product Officer at R Squared AI. Builder of AI systems, automation tools, and operational infrastructure. Based in Hays, Kansas.

---

## Professional Identity

Tyler Preisser is the Chief Product Officer at R Squared AI, an AI consulting and integration firm (Delaware C-Corp, incorporated December 2025). R Squared AI builds production-grade agentic AI solutions for PE portfolio companies, financial services, and insurance clients. The company was co-founded with Rich Rivara (CEO, 50% equity) and Will Godfrey (CTO, 40% equity). Tyler holds 10% equity.

Tyler also founded Preisser Solutions, an automation consulting practice that builds custom dashboards, back-office workflows, internal tooling, and reporting engines for businesses.

## Career Arc

- Farm kid from age 4 — grew up on Kansas farmland operating equipment and managing harvest operations
- Self-taught in technology via YouTube starting in middle school
- Built social media audiences of hundreds of thousands of followers across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and Snapchat
- National entrepreneurship competition wins throughout college
- High school electromagnetic pulsation motor invention
- Construction management experience from age 7 through jobsite and subcontractor management
- Door-to-door painting sales
- Top Verizon wireless sales performer — highest sales per customer in the country for his store
- VP of Operations at HG Oil Holdings (Kansas oil producer) — built agentic AI systems for invoice processing, vendor insurance verification, POI certifications, and payment automation
- Co-founded R Squared AI in June 2025

## Projects

1. **BIA** — Hydroelectric animal-saving water filtration system using power generated from pre-existing water pressure to purify water runoff
2. **R Squared AI** — $1M+ revenue AI consulting firm building agentic AI solutions for businesses
3. **Preisser Solutions** — Automation company building custom dashboards, workflows, and internal tooling
4. **Wife Supply Co.** — AI-powered gifting platform synthesizing partner preferences for perfect gift ideas
5. **SkySprayers** — Autonomous agricultural spray-drone docking station with CAD and full-size prototype
6. **Yard Inventory Systems** — Live oil field parts and equipment tracking for energy sector operations
7. **Agentic Back Office Automations** — Automated manual business processes for operational efficiency
8. **The Iron and Oak Podcast** — Protestant Christian ministry podcast co-founded with Lincoln Myers
9. **Preisser Media** — 300K+ followers, 30M+ views across social platforms
10. **CarBubble** — Collapsible protective vehicle shelter concept with multiple working prototypes
11. **Whole Home CAD Design** — Residential construction designs with innovative layouts
12. **Custom Jewelry Design** — Bespoke engagement rings designed in Autodesk Inventor and SOLIDWORKS
13. **AI Submission Engine (Insurance)** — Production document-extraction system for a large enterprise insurance brokerage; classifies broker submission packets, auto-populates Salesforce with dual-model validation, and integrates Salesforce with the Majesco rating engine, cutting processing from hours to minutes (via R Squared AI)
14. **Forge** — Autonomous, OpenClaw-native pipeline that researches a business, studies the best sites in its industry, then builds and deploys a premium custom website end to end (Preisser Solutions)
15. **Query Dominance Agent System** — 10-agent, 6-phase system that predicts every query a prospect might run, audits who wins it across Google and AI search, and outputs an executable 90-day plan to take the top result (Preisser Solutions)
16. **Alpha Matrix** — 6-agent stock-analysis system (Scanner, Sentiment, Quant, Pattern Matcher, Conviction Scorer, Portfolio Strategist) where each agent self-evolves via "soul files" tuned by prediction accuracy
17. **Customer Reactivation Engine** — Used AI to clean years of scattered dispatch data into clean segments for a regional home-services company, then built the schedule and targeted messaging that re-engaged dormant customers — reactivating 60%+ within six weeks and lifting booking conversion 45%+ (Preisser Solutions)
18. **Agentic Operations Automation (Oil & Gas)** — Built in-house as VP of Operations: agentic systems for invoice processing, vendor insurance verification, POI certifications, and payment automation (HG Oil)
